notes: Page has two builds: left column steps 1-4 (chassis), right column steps 1-5 (hinged arm sub-assembly); the top-right picture is the preview of the finished chassis.

Piece identities and stacking are partly guessed from small illustrations: the chassis base is taken as 4600 + 3021 overlapping, then second 4600 and 3020, then clips 6019 on the left and black 48336 at the right end, then a yellow 1x2 plate on top.
Arm: hinge plate 73983, black clips on top, yellow 1x2 plates and black 1x1 plates added in steps 3-4 (assumed), then black 48336 with yellow corner panel 6231 clipped on at step 5.
Wheels, tyres and remaining parts are not used on this page.

Page 2 shows step 6 (arm attached to chassis), step 7 (three trans-brown panels as cab walls and a yellow 2x3 plate as roof), step 8 (wheels with tyres and a yellow 1x4 panel on a black clip plate as front blade). The rest of the page is advertising.
Big wheels 6014b with tyres 6015 are assumed at the rear (by the arm); small wheels 4624 with tyres 3641 at the front by the blade.
Several parts from the parts list (2x 3020, 47457, 44674, 2x 4085c, 6231, 73983) are not clearly shown on this page. Page 1 guesses may have used the wrong parts, so these are left unplaced.
Cab panel placement and which pieces carry the wheels and blade are guesses from small pictures.

The check flagged parts not yet placed: 2x 3020, 2x 4085c, 44674, 47457, 6231, 73983. Each is used once in the booklet, so they are added here as pieces. The booklet pictures are small, so where they go is partly guessed.

The 3020 plates, mudguard 44674 and curved brick 47457 are taken as the yellow body layers in the chassis preview picture (page 1 step 5 and page 2 step 6). They are placed on top of the earlier chassis plates as a guess.
The second 73983 with its two 4085c clips and second corner panel 6231 are taken as the second half of the arm, since the arm picture shows two hinge sections. This is a guess.
Earlier page-1 piece choices were also guesses, so some parts may sit in a different step than the booklet shows. The part counts now match the parts list.
